recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell at write time

previousStrategy.role: precedent only (replacements first, then primaries); not re-used as this window's strategy

currentGenerationState.source: the post-P:12 mixed-window evidence adjudication (156df2a) plus the six-entry replacement ledger, re-derived in this step with the landed harness; not memory

frozenStrategyRules: pending replacement obligations come before untouched primaries
multiple obligations are ordered by selectionIndex ascending
unused reserves are walked monotonically in frozen reserve-rank order
untouched primaries continue by selectionIndex ascending
a replacement inherits its slot's split
a failed reserve creates a same-slot replacement chain
the next chain link replaces the current reserve occupant, not the original selection
no dynamic insertion or window enlargement
strategy selection does not assign or consume a reserve
reserve consumption occurs only after a future canonical ledger row is appended, committed and pushed before institution network
no institution identity, website characteristic, expected yield, split composition or past outcome chooses or orders work

windowSize.source: Corpus Plan V1 batchingPlan.recommendedBatchSize = 5; no amendment changes it

strategyOptions.name: REPLACEMENT_ONLY
strategyOptions.assessment: clears the sole owed obligation and preserves reserve order, but uses only one of the recommended five bounded-review positions and advances no untouched primary

strategyOptions.name: PRIMARIES_ONLY
strategyOptions.assessment: preserves primary order and size 5, but defers an already-owed same-slot replacement obligation through another complete window

strategyOptions.name: MIXED_ONE_REPLACEMENT_PLUS_FOUR_PRIMARIES
strategyOptions.assessment: clears every currently owed obligation in the next precommit, advances four untouched primaries, keeps the recommended size 5, preserves reserve and primary order, follows the replacements-first precedent (Window V1, post-P:12 mixed window), is result-blind and needs no adaptive insertion

comparisonBasis: methodology and governance fit only; no institution identity, website, expected yield, split preference or prior institution performance was consulted

orderRationale: the one replacement already owed by frozen methodology comes first
untouched primaries then continue in frozen selection order from 16
the combined order is also ascending selectionIndex: 12, 16, 17, 18, 19
no split or identity characteristic is consulted
all five items are precommitted before any future network execution
candidateWindow.drawEntryDigestMethod: drawEntrySha256 = sha256(canonicalStringify(exact parsed draw entry)), landed drawEntrySha256 (windowPlan.ts); the replacement digests draw.reserve[6], primaries digest draw.selection[selectionIndex]

proof.method: validateReplacementLedger + currentOccupantForSelectionIndex + planPendingReplacementObligations over the validated six-entry ledger (scratchpad script, not committed)

futureRowConstraints.derivation: prepareReplacementAppend derives replacedOccupantKind and previousSequenceForSlot from the slot's latest entry; validateReplacementLedger enforces both

failureSemantics.replacementFailure: the failed reserve stays the slot's current occupant; a further same-slot obligation arises only after adjudication; reserve 7 or later is never assigned inside the same window
failureSemantics.primaryFailure: evidence preserved; no reserve assigned inside the same window; obligation only after adjudication

supports.oneReplacementPlusFourPrimaries: candidate items of both kinds with replacementItems/primaryItems counts
supports.sixEntryStartingLedger: re-hashes the supplied ledger bytes, validates against the draw, requires ledgerExtendsGenesis and entries === bound entries
supports.plannedReplacementSequence6: reserve positions must equal planPendingReplacementObligations (next unused = entryCount), and precommittedWindowSpecViolations requires position = startingLedger.entryCount + k
supports.replacesOccupantReserveReplacement: replacesOccupant is DERIVED from currentOccupantForSelectionIndex; a claim that disagrees is refused
supports.previousSequenceForSlot5: not a spec field; derived by prepareReplacementAppend and enforced by validateReplacementLedger and the P7 planned-append match (replacedOccupantKind)
supports.currentFailuresAndPendingObligations: accepted; each obligation must be a current failure, and each replacement must discharge one with the same reason
supports.callerSuppliedPlanIdentity: WindowPlanIdentity input; refused if it reuses the strategy identity
supports.specFromStrategyDrawAndLedgerOnly: inputs are draw, strategy bytes, strategy file facts, starting-ledger bytes and identity; no plan is an input
